question.text: 'Godavari Impact AIF' (Category II) must carry out annual PPM compliance audit. By when must the audit findings along with corrective steps be communicated to the Trustee, Board of Manager and SEBI?

answer.text: Within 30 days from the end of the financial year
Within 3 months from the end of the financial year
Within 6 months from the end of the financial year
Within 12 months from the end of the financial year

explanation.text: The Logic: Per Section 13.5.2, the findings of the PPM audit, along with corrective steps if any, shall be communicated to the Trustee or Board or Designated Partners of the AIF, Board of the Manager, and SEBI within 6 months from the end of the financial year. The Trap: 30 days applies to PPM change intimation. 3 months is not applicable. 12 months would be too late — regulator needs timely compliance reporting. Cross-Exam Context: XIX-A recalls 6 months. XIX-C requires knowledge of what sections of PPM are optional for audit (Risk Factors, Legal/Regulatory/Tax, Track Record of First Time Managers, Illustration of Fees, Glossary). Manager's Pro-Tip: Start the PPM audit in April itself — appointing an external auditor and scoping the review takes ~60 days. Leaving it to September creates a rushed filing with higher error risk.
